$description: Design tokens in the W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) format. THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the design system. Edit values here only -- do not hand-edit the generated src/index.css or src/generated/tokens.ts. The dev server regenerates them on every change (scripts/build-tokens.mjs, wired through vite.config.ts). Colors are authored as hex; the generator converts them to `H S% L%` channels for the web theme and keeps hex for mobile (tokens.ts). Every color role exists in both light and dark. Rebound: Trampoline Note's performance-ledger language extracted from the live app -- pure-black ground (dark is the canonical mode), electric blue accent fading to indigo, hairline borders, uppercase Inter micro-labels (monospace is banned), tabular numerals.

foreground.$description: Near-black ink with a cool blue cast.

border.$description: Hairline. Panels usually soften it further (border/50-60).

primary.$description: Electric blue (blue-600 on paper). Drives CTAs, active states, and the head of the signature blue-to-indigo gradient.

accent.$description: Blue wash for selected pills and active nav items.

chart3.$description: Amber -- ratings, PB/gold surfaces (--gold aliases this).

chart4.$description: Indigo, deepened for contrast on paper -- the gradient tail; pairs with primary.

background.$description: Pure black ground. The canonical Rebound mode -- the app boots dark.

border.$description: Hairline -- reads as white/10 on the ground; panels soften it further (border/55-62).

card.$description: Panels are usually transparent with a hairline border; card fill is for floating surfaces.

primary.$description: Electric blue (blue-500). White ink on solid fills; text accents fade toward indigo via the gradient utility.

accent.$description: Blue-tinted fill for selected pills and active nav items.

chart3.$description: Amber-400 -- ratings, PB/gold surfaces (--gold aliases this).

chart4.$description: Indigo-400 -- the gradient tail; pairs with primary.

sans.$description: The only typeface. Headlines run font-black with tight (-0.04em to -0.05em) tracking; big figures are font-semibold tabular-nums.

serif.$description: Intentionally aliased to the sans stack -- Rebound is a single-face system.

mono.$description: MONOSPACE IS BANNED (user decision, Aug 2026). font-mono resolves to Inter on purpose so micro-labels/codes render in the sans stack. Never reintroduce a real mono face.

base.$description: Base corner radius (12px); sm/md/lg/xl derive from this. Pills and segmented controls are fully rounded.
